_meta.derived_from: _cache/ocr_bench/summary.md (6 samples: transcript/handwritten/transcript-alt/form Phase-0 DOJ + CL motion + SCOTUS cert)
_meta.quality_proxy: fragment_ratio (words of length <=2 / total) — lower is better; validated manually on DOJ-OGR-00022402 where PSM 6 output matches ground-truth transcript exactly

pdf_text_layer.use_when: PDF has an extractable text layer (pdftotext returns >=50 chars with fragment_ratio<=0.2 on probe page)

scanned_typed.use_when: scanned document (TIFF/JPG or image-only PDF) with typed text — transcripts, forms, memos
scanned_typed.fallback_trigger: chars < 200 OR (fragment_ratio > 0.40 AND chars < 500) — avoids false-positives on line-numbered transcripts where frag naturally runs 0.23-0.36

scanned_sparse_or_handwritten.use_when: mostly-blank scan, handwriting, or photo — PSM 6 collapses to <50 chars on these (observed on DOJ-OGR-00002641)

placeholder.use_when: every pipeline returns <30 chars — emit bates skeleton claim, skip OCR

DOJ-OGR-00002641 (handwritten).note: PSM 3 picks up a header stamp that PSM 6 misses; Gemini + PSM 3 tie on content — escalate to Gemini when PSM 6 returns <100c

DOJ-OGR-00000353 (form).note: tesseract close; keep PSM 6 as primary given cost
